reviewed_by: Codex focused review for MCP catalog filtering and worker boundaries
reason: Validate SQL exclusion before hydration, catalogs beyond 1000 rows, fresh permissions and project ownership, async provider/harness capability entry points, inherited and explicit child selections, IPC behavior, and existing delegation cancellation/message/wait contracts. A paired disposable LAN Core benchmark exercises 34 concurrent authenticated gateway connections and unrelated HTTP reads. Concurrent explicit selections must recheck child idempotency after the worker read.
exclusions: Backend query/scheduling only. No interface controls, settings schemas, origin behavior, native runtime or live vendor changes; frontend, native and Playwright layers are excluded. Source Core with synthetic static assets validates HTTP responsiveness. No full suites, production data or deployment.
